en: As you can see, we're having a little breakfast in the backyard patio of our Airbnb which we're in love with.
zh: 如你所见，我们正在我们的 Airbnb 的后院露台上吃点早餐，我们太喜欢这里了。

en: I need to put some hot sauce on this.
She has been getting on my case about this.
Is anybody else addicted to hot sauce, specifically Frank's red hot?
zh: 有没有人也对辣酱上瘾，特别是 Frank's Red Hot？

en: It's insulting when you make a meal and somebody just douses it in hot sauce.
zh: 做了一顿饭，你一上来就全倒上辣酱，真的有点不尊重人。

en: It doesn't take away from the cooking you did.
zh: 这并不会贬低你做饭的功劳。

en: I put hot sauce on everything.
On chips, on eggs, on meat.
Anyways, we have a couple of fun days planned and some work to do.
zh: 总之，我们接下来几天安排了些有趣的事，也有一些工作要做。

en: We thought it'd be fun if we brought you guys with us for a typical few days in our lives living in New York. Yes.
zh: 我们觉得如果带你们一起体验我们在纽约生活的几天会很有趣。没错。

en: Starting with work though. We have a lot to do. We have so much.
zh: 不过先从工作开始。我们有很多事情要做。真的很多。
